text:
olivia: Quick sync: PR #523 adds a short 'Optimize: quick migration' section focused on batching + quant profiles. Needs a short docs pass and a tiny migration checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood/optimize/pull/523
sam: Pinged the docs squad. Can we keep examples copy-paste-ready (no extra imports)? Prefer showing client.batch() and a minimal quant YAML.
anya: Short Python example (v2 SDK, batch + kv prefetch):
```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key='${REDWOOD}')
# batch two prompts and enable kv prefetch to warm KV cache for chat flows
results = client.batch.text.generate([
  { 'model': 'redwood/opt-3', 'prompt': 'Summarize the incident timeline' },
  { 'model': 'redwood/opt-3', 'prompt': 'Extract top 3 root causes' }
], options={ 'kv_prefetch': True })
for r in results:
  print(r.text)
```
kevin: Compact quant profile suggestion (YAML). Call out short-input fallback to float32 to avoid tiny-sequence drift:
```yaml
precision: q8_0
kv_prefetch: true
prefetch_policy: aggressive
shortseq_policy:
  max_tokens: 16
  fallback_precision: float32
```
olivia: Add one-line cost guidance in docs: "Typical memory reduction ~2.5-4x with q8/q4; validate on a suite of 10-50 representative prompts."
sam: Node snippet that demonstrates batch + streaming-friendly option (keeps it tiny):
```js
const { Client } = require('@redwood/inference')
const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD })
const res = await client.batch.text.generate([
  { model: 'redwood/opt-3', prompt: 'Summarize logs' },
  { model: 'redwood/opt-3', prompt: 'List errors' }
], { kv_prefetch: true, stream: false })
res.forEach(r => console.log(r.outputText))
```
anya: Editorial nit: use single-quote strings in examples and avoid extra comments. Also include a 3-line migration checklist in the PR description: 1) update SDK examples to v2 batch/text APIs, 2) include compact quant profile YAML + shortseq fallback, 3) run smoke eval and paste tokens/cost delta.
kevin: Suggest adding a tiny troubleshooting note: if accuracy drops on short prompts, try raising max_tokens in shortseq_policy or temporarily use float32 for that endpoint. Also link to the Eval playbook.
olivia: Can someone run the smoke eval (10 prompts float32 vs q8_0) and paste the numbers into the PR? Even a small table is fine. I'll merge once CI and the smoke eval are attached.
sam: I'll run it and post results by EOD.
merge-bot: label applied: docs/needs-review
olivia: Thanks all — on merge please have merge-bot generate a changelog bullet and ping #release-war-room with the 3-line checklist.
